mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, images, is_accepted, like_count, created_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{postId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{parentId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{isAccepted}, #{likeCount}, #{createdAt})
